sources.facts: Paperback custom trim bounds accommodate 185 x 240 mm. Both dimensions put it in the large-trim price band. Premium colour uses nominal 88–105 gsm white paper; standard colour nominal 74–90 gsm white paper, with location-dependent variation.
sources.unresolved: Official calculator now accepts custom 185 x 240 mm for both standard and premium colour. File acceptance still needs the project-specific unpublished title/Previewer, after metadata decisions.

sources.facts: KDP requires single pages, embedded fonts, at least 7 pt type and 300 dpi images. Full-bleed interior pages need 3.175 mm beyond top, bottom and outside trim edges; covers need bleed on every edge. Transparency requires flattening before submission. Draft placeholders must be removed before upload. Sequential folios must match left/right page parity.

Bookvault normally requires 3 mm of real extended artwork at each trimmed edge, giving 191 x 246 mm full-bleed pages for 185 x 240 mm trim. No printer marks. Confirm against the generated specification template.
The anonymous quote tool can provide sizing templates before a title is created. Cover dimensions and spine must use the selected binding, trim and page count.

Bookvault checks corruption, dimensions, page count, font embedding and indicated barcode presence. Passing validation does not check transparency or actual artwork extension into bleed. PDF/X-1a:2001 or PDF/X-3:2002 is recommended where possible.

KDP publishes 12.7 mm inside margin for 151–300 pages and 9.6 mm top/bottom/outside margins for bleed manuscripts. Apply margins in the correct full-bleed file coordinate system; do not confuse bleed-edge and trim-edge distances.
UK large-trim colour tariff rechecked on 6 October: standard GBP0.85 + GBP0.027/page; premium GBP0.85 + GBP0.0598/page. Public rates agree with calculator scenario.

Paperback file conversion limit is 650 MB. Remove placeholders and non-printing objects, embed fonts/images, flatten transparency. Guidelines also specify minimum 0.75 pt lines; full line-weight and transparency preflight remain pending.
Digital print-ready PDFs; PDF/X-1a:2001 or PDF/X-3:2002 recommended. Exact template supplied for specification.
